raised: The fee is never given as an actual number
Unclear whether the 3.25% rate is before or after the fee
Doesn't know which fund to pick or how to buy one
'No guaranteed return' and 'no state guarantee' made the reader nervous
The '123 מקורו / חושב / הזנתי' legend was confusing
The cut-off hour and settlement paragraph in מה זה was too technical
Codes like MF-11 and 'MF OQ3 שאלה פתוחה' were confusing (can I trade on Friday?)
The management-fee paragraph was cut off before the number appeared
The deposit comparison in למה משתמשים בזה was long
The 'שחקו עם המספרים שלכם' calculator was collapsed; reader wanted it open
Didn't fully understand 'אין דמי משמרת' (no custody fee)
The cost table only says 'אין תקרה בחוק' and never says how much you pay
The tax summary cards were partly cut off
The chart's bar lengths and colours (and the deposit bar starting halfway) weren't understood
Didn't understand the 'לפי ריבית בנק ישראל' tags or why the return is tied to that rate
Unsure what 'עליית המדד' / 'הרווח הריאלי' mean
Terms like נאמן, מפיץ and סלקה weren't understood
Securities-account custody fee looks contradictory between the glossary and the cost table
No worked example of what you'd actually end up with after fee and tax
No guidance on choosing among the 73 funds
No information on whether these funds have ever lost money, or by how much
No one-sentence answer to 'can I get my money tomorrow?'

Would cut the rule codes and links, the 123 legend, מה האתר לקח בחשבון, the rules/where-it-appears columns, most of the glossary, the מי מציע paragraph, the technical cut-off paragraph and the loss-offset tax part

problems.why: The report never mentions Leumi, a single named bank, or a rate sourced from one bank; its comments on the comparison are about bar lengths, tags and alternatives, not about singling out one bank.
